stem.text: The $I$–$V$ characteristics for four components, **A**, **B**, **C** and **D**, are shown.
Which component has the greatest resistance when the potential difference across it is $V_1$?

stem.alt: I–V graph with vertical axis labelled current and horizontal axis labelled voltage, origin 0. Four curves start at the origin and are labelled A, B, C and D. A dashed vertical line is marked at V1.
